problem_statement:
Removes unnecessary use of markdown-it
The Github API already [offers a markdown version](https://developer.github.com/v3/media/#html) for the requests we're making, so it's not necessary to use markdown-it to process our requests.

However we still need it to format users comments, so we're still using it on  all of the pages where people can write comments. It might be worth it to look for a more specific lib to do this job.
